data.body:
[P2] Use native completion timestamps for non-timeout invocations

For completed non-timeout requests, `InvocationCompletedDetails.EndTimestamp` is ignored and `endedAtMs` remains the wrapper-return timestamp. With wrapper return at 40 ms, native completion at 70 ms, and warm admission at 50 ms, normalization supplies an end of 40 ms and defeats the base validator's native sequential-reuse check. Validate and retain the service end for every completed request, preserving wrapper exit as a separate event. Add a non-timeout normalization regression covering this interval.
